mu_name_from: MuMain loads the set at index 24 from Data/Player/PantMale25.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:200-210: the sets at index 21-24 are files 22-25, `22 + i`). MU's group 9 number 24.
why_this_one: The Muse Elf's second set, after Divine (the user, 2026-10-10: 'cook them', the next sets and weapons after the strongest the heroes have). docs/game/second-class-gear.md.

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (0.75 and 0.95d have no second-class sets).
stats.class_level_note: The Muse Elf's alone: OpenMU's elfClassLevel 2. sim::fits asks Wearer::second (docs/game/second-class-gear.md).

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py: red lacquered plate traced in silver over a red pleated skirt and black leather; FShoots_R a violet band; level_man033 her own head and hair, level_man01 the leather under the plate; hide is MU's black cap over the openings.
material_note: painted_steel with plate_steel's cast grain at Divine's depth, as her first set: red lacquer, silver painted on. FPants01, the pleated skirt, is cloth; level_man01 under the plate is leather; level_man033 is her hair and face.
material_overrides_note: As Divine's: plate_steel's cast grain, at depth 0.02 and range 0.03, since on a glossy lacquer a deeper pit catches its own glint (2026-10-04, 'micro white points').
effects_note: MuMain's only arms for the set are the helm's and the pants' slow breath on FShoots_R (see glow_note); no chrome pass.
glow_note: `case MODEL_RED_SPIRIT_PANTS: case MODEL_RED_SPIRIT_HELM`: BlendMeshLight = sin(WorldTime*0.001)*0.4+0.6 (ZzzObject.cpp:5248-5250, again at :9945-9948), and FShoots_R's `_R` makes TextureScript draw that mesh bright (TextureScript.cpp:38): the violet band breathes, added, at the 2nd wings' slow rate (pulse_rate slow, pipeline/cook.py mode bit 3).
